subject: DPIA & audit evidence request for onboarding - EnableBank
messages:
From: Sara Khan <sara.khan@enablebank.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Request: DPIA support + Art. 28/30 evidence for onboarding

Ben —

Thanks for the demo last week. As part of EnableBank's onboarding risk review I need to collect a small evidence package and confirm audit rights for the account before we go live. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide the following by EOW (ideally in redacted form for initial review):

- Short DPIA summary describing high-level processing risks and mitigations (we only need a 1–2 page summary at this stage)
- Export of your Article 30 processing register (activities/scope) filtered to processing related to our account
- Current subprocessor inventory (region + purpose + subprocessors handling EU payer data)
- Confirmation of ability to produce 90-day ingress/egress logs and a sample ledger extract for audit sampling (redacted)
- Confirmation of onshore routing options (EU-only hosting if available) and KMS key wrapping details
- Copy of your standard DPA and whether you accept our procurement redlines (I understand this may need legal review)

We will likely need to run a short DPIA workshop with our privacy team if anything material appears — please flag anything you think will trigger that. Procurement may also send a formal evidence RFQ after this initial packet.

Attachments: none from my side yet; procurement contact is procurement@enablebank.com

Thanks,
Sara Khan
Head of Privacy, EnableBank
--
Sara Khan | Head of Privacy
EnableBank

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request: DPIA support + Art. 28/30 evidence for onboarding

Sara — thanks for the clear hit list. We can support all of that; want to confirm a couple of scopes before we assemble the packet:

- Article 30 export: do you want the full processing register or just entries scoped to EnableBank (we can filter by account ID)?
- Logs: we'll provide a 90-day sampling window as redacted ledger extracts; full raw logs require a formal audit pathway — is your request for sample extracts for review sufficient for now?
- DPA: we can push our standard DPA + a marked copy with common legal redlines. If you send procurement redlines we can triage with Legal.

I'll coordinate the evidence bundle and upload to a shared drive. Marissa / Irene — can you own producing the artifacts below? Proposed deliverables: art30 export (filtered), dpia-summary (1–2p redacted), subprocessor inventory (regionalized), ledger sample (90 days, redacted), onshore-routing matrix, and DPA + redlines note. Target to share initial bundle by Thu EOD (11/12) if that's acceptable.

Sara — are there any additional format constraints (CSV vs XLSX) for the registers?

Best,
Ben
Senior Privacy Solutions, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com
+1 415 555 0123

Ben / Irene —

I can take the DPIs, Art30 and subprocessor inventory. Proposed split: I will produce the dpia-summary-redacted.pdf and the art30-processing-register.csv (filtered by EnableBank account ID). Irene — can you pull the subprocessor-inventory.xlsx and onshore-routing-matrix.pdf (note: the matrix needs the per-region routing options we maintain + which suppliers are onshore EU)?

Notes / caveats for packet:
- Art30 export: will include processing categories, purposes, legal basis, and subprocessors only at the catalogue level (we must redact identifiers).
- Subprocessor inventory: we'll include vendor name, region, purpose, and last-attested SOC/ISO where available. Some smaller infra partners are covered by our platform-level SOC and cannot be listed at the instance level — will flag those as "platform-level" and provide attestation statements.
- Ledger extract: I'll generate a sample ledger (last 90 days) with hashed identifiers; this will be attached as a CSV stub (ledger-sample-90d.csv).
- DPA: Legal will prepare a standard DPA and a short memo on common redlines. We should avoid sending unexecuted DPA via Drive; better to route DocuSign when ready.

Action items:
- Marissa: dpia-summary-redacted.pdf, art30-processing-register.csv (by 11/12 EOD)
- Irene: subprocessor-inventory.xlsx, onshore-routing-matrix.pdf, ledger-sample-90d.csv (by 11/12 EOD)
- Ben: coordinate with Legal on DPA redlines and provide DocuSign envelope once live

I'll add a short README in the Drive explaining redactions and scope.

Marissa

Thanks — that scope looks good. A couple of clarifications from my privacy team and procurement:

- Art. 30: filtered entries scoped to EnableBank are fine for initial review. We may ask for the full register later but the filtered export is perfect for now.
- Logs/Ledger: sample extracts are fine for the initial packet. If we proceed to an audit we will request the formal audit pathway.
- Formats: CSV or XLSX both acceptable; CSV preferred for the register export.
- DPA redlines: procurement will send redlines via DocuSign once they have the standard DPA. For now please share the standard DPA as a PDF and a short note on how Redwood typically responds to the following clauses: data residency, subprocessors, and audit rights.

Procurement also requested a signed confirmation that Redwood can: provide on-prem or VPC evidence if escalation occurs, and provide an audit window of 30 business days notice for any live audit. Would you confirm those points?

Sara

- On-prem/VPC evidence: we do offer Private deployment packages (VPC / on-prem options) for regulated customers; those fall under a separate contract and will be scoped by Solutions/Legal.
